check: Prediction and planned n written in a manifest before the first scored call; design for two-sided surprise (either outcome updates someone); research question phrased falsifiably or labelled exploratory
value_reason: stops post-hoc storytelling; one line written by the agent
disposition_why: near-free; merge the six statements into checklists/research.md:7 and point at it

check: Measurement must be defined before an idea is ready ('how would I score this?'); metric extraction is programmatic
value_reason: an unscorable idea wastes days, not minutes
risk_reason: kills ideas early, speeds the queue
disposition_why: directly serves iteration speed

check: Sort ideas by time-to-first-signal (day-test); babble-and-prune loop
value_reason: a prioritisation heuristic, not an error check
disposition_why: it is the owner's stated priority written as a rule

check: Name the embarrassingly simple baseline (linear probe, just ask the model, random/majority) before proposing a method
value_reason: a trivial baseline matching the method voids the result
disposition_why: cheap and frequently decisive

check: Threat-model paragraph written before design, naming who controls the prompt
value_reason: kills or sharpens ill-posed monitor/defence ideas
disposition_why: cheap; scoped to defence/monitor work by nature

check: Spend about an hour attacking your own defence/monitor with the simplest adaptive attack; report the adaptive condition beside the static one; an unattacked detector is untested
value_reason: detectors collapse under adaptation (89%->2%, 74%->3.4% recorded)
risk_reason: an hour-long timebox and a second condition per detector, if read as per-iteration
disposition_why: require it before a detector claim is quoted or published, not on every exploratory iteration

check: Name independent variable(s) and levels including accidental ones (changed prompt, renderer, model version), dependent variable, unit of analysis, aggregation and the null
value_reason: accidental IVs (prompt format 23-30pp; one-sentence inoculation) can be the whole effect
risk_reason: a short list the agent writes
disposition_why: highest value-per-minute design check

check: Every causal contrast declares factors changed and its matched control; one factor at a time by default; randomised factorial where an interaction is plausible
value_reason: one-factor sweeps can misattribute interactions
disposition_why: keep one-factor default and the declaration; make the factorial opt-in when an interaction is the question

check: Name alternative explanations and plan the ablation that separates them with the experiment, not after the headline
value_reason: an un-ablatable alternative becomes a permanent caveat
risk_reason: adds conditions but planned up front
disposition_why: core of the method; merge agent copies into research.md:51

check: Narrow finetune organisms need at least one confound-matched or scrambled-label control beside the headline (dataset cues, length, format, verbalised eval awareness)
value_reason: narrow finetunes are where length/format confounds dominate
disposition_why: scoped to finetune work already; the cost buys the causal claim

check: Statistical power / sample-size planning (n ~ 8 Var/delta^2, power > 0.8; ~1000 questions for 3pp); nulls reported with CI of the difference and detectable effect at N
value_reason: prevents reading an underpowered null as no effect
risk_reason: pushes toward large n, which slows each iteration
disposition_why: report the detectable effect at the n you chose instead of mandating n for power 0.8

check: Research spec interview (15 categories, 2-4 questions per round, resources checked inline) before an experiment is built; spec published as an Artifact
value_reason: surfaces confounds and baselines before code
risk_reason: multiple human rounds; only fires when invoked
disposition_why: opt-in by trigger; reserve for a new research line, not each run

check: research-engineer pre-run BLOCKING spec validation: 9 items (hyperparams with justification, output path, hypothesis, metrics, datasets, graphs planned, caching, concurrency, error handling); STOP and wait for the user to edit the spec; warnings ask Y/n
value_reason: most items are bookkeeping (graphs planned, concurrency) that do not change a result
risk_reason: human wait before any code; contradicts 'commit and run'
disposition_why: replace with the agent filling these into the manifest itself, logging assumptions, and proceeding

check: verification-planning: EnterPlanMode before running an experiment, analysing results or verifying; require_plan_approval hook then tells Claude to ask the user before entering plan mode
value_reason: planning verification is good, but plan mode plus approval adds no check on the result
risk_reason: two human gates per experiment/analysis in this repo
disposition_why: dotfiles-repo only today; drop the 'running an experiment' and 'analysing results' rows so it never spreads to research repos

check: Research-loop: mandatory 15-question interview (4 gates, reject vague answers), readiness check, spec approval, then pilot before the autonomous loop
value_reason: a vague answer costs a whole unattended night
risk_reason: paid once per loop, not per iteration; the loop itself then runs without a human
disposition_why: front-loads the human so the overnight loop iterates freely

check: A run of a night or longer gets its own pre-launch review, iterated until Yulong is happy, then launch
value_reason: a night of compute on a wrong config is the costliest single miss
risk_reason: human gate; can delay a launch by hours if Yulong is away
disposition_why: keep the review, but allow launch on a stated default after a timeout when the run is cheap and reversible

check: Two-stage pilot, both hard gates: stage 1 n=1-2 every stage end-to-end and eyeballed; stage 2 n>=4 watching peak RSS and longest input; nothing to full scale before both pass
value_reason: catches pipeline bugs and OOM before spend
risk_reason: two short runs; saves far more than it costs
disposition_why: one --pilot flag in the runner that does both stages and prints RSS and longest input; stage 2 can fold into stage 1 for cheap API-only runs

check: Every spending stage has a --dry-run you actually read; Inspect preflight (engine idle, endpoint answers /v1/models, dry-run completes) before every launch
value_reason: launch-blocking faults found in about 90 s instead of about 2 h (recorded)
disposition_why: build once per harness; then it costs seconds

check: Audit inputs for truncation, chrome and placeholder tokens, with counts, before any stage consumes them
value_reason: silently corrupted inputs change every downstream number
disposition_why: make it a reusable input-audit step

check: Fail-fast preflight: endpoint health, disk for 3x output, memory vs reader budgets, auth; estimate $, GPU-h, peak RSS, tokens out loud; resources validated inline during spec
value_reason: protects run survival, not result correctness
disposition_why: fold into the dry-run preflight (P02)

check: Contamination: record dataset/split hashes; state the check run (canary, n-gram/embedding overlap) or state none was possible; few-shot pool disjoint from test; never reuse a test item across compared conditions
value_reason: H for finetune/few-shot work; the stated caveat is cheap
disposition_why: the disjointness rules are free; actual overlap scans only for finetune work. Merge the two checklist copies

check: Spend gate: estimate from actual rates; under $100 run and report; $100 or more propose and wait; cluster allocations exempt
value_reason: cost control, not correctness
risk_reason: human wait above $100; zero cost below
disposition_why: the threshold already keeps most iterations ungated; the rules/ restatement is deliberate (always-on tier) but costs always-on budget, so it is a trim candidate

check: Debug on one-sample runs or fixtures; never relaunch the full run with a print added
value_reason: avoids hour-long debug cycles
disposition_why: pro-iteration

check: Validate outputs as they land (stream checks), not after the run
value_reason: a broken scorer found at row 10 instead of row 10,000
disposition_why: a per-row validator in the runner

check: Append-only resumable pipelines; resume and cache keys include prompt, model, sampling params and config hashes
value_reason: an under-keyed cache silently reuses stale rows after a prompt edit
disposition_why: pays for itself on the second run

check: Route by shape: >2 GB RSS or >1 h to the jexp queue; API fan-out backgrounded from main; never detached inside a subagent; outputs on /workspace; never leave GPUs idle
enforced: advisory (nudge_experiment_jobs wired but disabled by nudges = off)
value_reason: infrastructure; orphaned subagent jobs do mis-report success
risk_reason: queue adds latency for small jobs
disposition_why: not a rigour rule; leave as is; decide whether to delete the dead nudge

check: Analysis readers past ~2 GB run under `capped` (MemoryMax, one heavy reader per box, fails closed)
value_reason: protects the host, not the numbers
risk_reason: the exclusive lock serialises analysis; fail-closed can stop a read
disposition_why: cheap insurance against losing every run on the box

check: Inspect AI: read sampling config back from persisted ModelEvent requests; set max_samples explicitly and confirm from server logs; provider fields via extra_body; guard stop_reason; post-run validator against a pinned fingerprint; do not edit digest-bearing files mid-run
value_reason: config surface and wire bytes differ silently (dropped top_k, 1-way concurrency)
risk_reason: fail-closed validator and digest rule can void a finished run
disposition_why: one shared validator; keep the digest rule but warn before editing fingerprinted files

check: Hosted models drift under a fixed name: compared conditions run in the same window; a changed judge, endpoint or snapshot is an instrument change
value_reason: cross-week comparisons can measure provider drift
disposition_why: cheap

check: Stochastic results quoted need >=2 seeds with variance reported, or temperature 0, and the report says which; exploration sizes breadth before depth
value_reason: a single T>0 draw quoted as a result can be noise
risk_reason: doubles compute and wall-clock for anything quoted
disposition_why: apply only to quoted/confirmatory numbers; exploration stays single-seed breadth-first (as inspect-ai-evals says); make 2 the one number across all files

check: Label each run exploratory or confirmatory; a sweep or loop winner, or anything that survived deletion, is a hypothesis needing fresh episodes before it is quoted; each finding labelled pre-specified or discovered, with slice/comparison counts
value_reason: selection over many variants is the main false-positive source
risk_reason: a label during iteration; the rerun is only due before quoting
disposition_why: it is what lets exploration stay fast and loose safely

check: Keep pinned revisions, seeds, prompt hashes, rendered inputs, git commit and hyperparameters with every run
value_reason: needed to reproduce or explain a number later
disposition_why: same artefact as the run manifest; record once

check: Use existing validated code for experiments (correct hyperparams, full data, validated metrics); ad-hoc only for dry runs
value_reason: an ad-hoc reimplementation silently measures something else
disposition_why: wire guard_existing_code.sh (nudge only) with wire_harness_hooks.py --apply

check: No hardcoded hyperparameters: CLI args/config only; flag bare numeric literals for lr, temperature, n_seeds etc.
value_reason: a plausible typed number replaces the configured one
disposition_why: wire the existing nudge

check: No mock or synthetic data outside unit tests; if data is unavailable, ask
value_reason: fabricated stand-in data reported as measured is the worst-case error
disposition_why: stated in five agent prompts; the only always-on statement is CLAUDE.md:38 (test on real data); wire the hook and add one line to checklists/experiments.md

check: No broad try/except in experiment code
value_reason: swallowed errors become silent missing rows
disposition_why: put once in checklists/experiments.md; agents point at it

check: Research code conventions: JSONL outputs, CLI args, logging to file, checkpointing
value_reason: conventions, rarely result-changing
disposition_why: harmless with agents; soften 'always' wording

check: Transcript review after every run: check-transcripts Tier-1 deterministic checks, then transcript-reviewer agent; sampled deliberately (~40% fail, 30% pass, 30% random), labels exported as rejoinable JSONL; CRITICAL marks the experiment INVALID
enforced: advisory (tool exists; automatic only inside autonomous-researcher)
value_reason: scorer misconfiguration is the commonest silent result-changer (e.g. 13% read where 69% was true)
risk_reason: Tier 1 is seconds; the agent runs in parallel with the next run
disposition_why: run Tier 1 automatically at the end of every run; agent review only before quoting

check: Check what the scorer/judge actually consumed (last message, final answer only, CoT vs action); screen organisms on reasoning, not only final answer; state the judge's surface
value_reason: scorer reading the wrong message changed 69% to 13% (recorded)
disposition_why: cheap and high-yield; fold into the Tier-1 transcript checks

check: Every surprise named carries a linked follow-up or a stated reason not to pursue; investigate, do not explain away; perfect results get more scrutiny
value_reason: surprises are where bugs show
risk_reason: can derail iteration into chasing every anomaly
disposition_why: log each surprise with a one-line disposition; a follow-up is required only when the surprise touches a quoted number

check: Delete guard machinery that broke more of the last ten runs than it caught, counted from the run log; 'delete freely' for checklist items nobody has failed in a year
value_reason: meta-check that keeps the other checks honest
disposition_why: this review is that rule being applied; add a run-log field for 'guard fired / guard broke run' so it can be counted

check: Every number ships with its null (chance band at that n, degenerate constant predictor) and its ceiling; chance-corrected effects (kappa, lift) beside raw; base rate and positive class named; chance line on every comparison plot
value_reason: trivial baselines are often most of a rate (TPR 1.0 for always-flag)
disposition_why: the single highest-value analysis rule

check: Permutation (marginal-preserving) null with resolution floor 1/(N+1), where cheap
value_reason: catches structure the closed-form null misses
disposition_why: already scoped to 'where cheap'

check: Behaviour-free (scaffold-only: lengths, counts, condition metadata) baseline reported separately from chance, labelled as a diagnostic of the organism
value_reason: a length-only predictor once hit AUROC 1.000 on a sabotage dataset
disposition_why: required for detection claims; reconcile the wording across the three files (see notes)

check: Every estimate has an interval naming what variation it covers and omits and the bias direction; unit of analysis and n at that unit beside it (cluster over questions, not seeds/tokens/rollouts)
value_reason: n=seeds instead of n=questions gives intervals that are too narrow (clustered SE up to ~3x per ci-standards)
risk_reason: automatic with a shared stats helper
disposition_why: one stats helper used by data-analyst and results pages

check: Which interval/test: Wilson for proportions (never normal approximation); paired interval or exact test on paired data; bootstrap otherwise; small denominators as counts (0/7)
value_reason: normal approximation misbehaves near 0 and 1
disposition_why: and delete the conflicting normal-approximation formula in ci-standards.md

check: Every comparison names its test, effect size in metric units and n per condition; practical vs statistical significance
value_reason: a p-value alone overstates small effects
disposition_why: cheap

check: Multiple-comparison correction (Bonferroni, FDR) when testing many hypotheses
value_reason: guards against p-hacking across slices
disposition_why: checklists ask for disclosure of comparison counts, not correction; pick one policy

check: Sensitivity check for every main finding (drop top/bottom 5%, alternative aggregation, subset); flag FRAGILE if it flips
value_reason: catches outlier-driven conclusions
disposition_why: cheap; lives only in data-analyst and ci-standards, consider moving to results-analysis.md

check: Slice by factors that could reverse or hide the finding (Simpson's paradox); per-threat-model breakdown rather than an average
value_reason: pooled numbers across unequal strata can reverse
risk_reason: every slice is another comparison (tension with U09)
disposition_why: pair with disclosed slice counts

check: Deterministic scorer where the construct has an exact surface form; LLM judge only for meaning, never regex/keywords for meaning; report the deterministic baseline beside the judge
value_reason: keyword matching misses paraphrase and counts quotations, both in the hypothesis's direction
risk_reason: chooses the cheaper tool where valid
disposition_why: two files agree; keep one statement

check: Judge hygiene: one sample per prompt; rationale before verdict; verbatim quote for positives; absence-fields hand-validated; blinded to labels, condition, other judges and hypothesis; prompts versioned with sha256; append-only JSONL with rendered input; parse failures counted
value_reason: batched or unblinded judging leaks between samples and toward the hypothesis
risk_reason: a reusable harness makes it free
disposition_why: ship a shared judge harness that enforces these by construction

check: Judge validation: agreement against a human-labelled gold subset (n and statistic named); paired comparisons in both orders or position bias measured; judge identity in provenance
value_reason: the judge is the measuring instrument
risk_reason: human labelling is a gate per judge
disposition_why: validate once per judge-prompt version and reuse; before publication, not per iteration

check: Condition labels come from design, never the measured quantity; scoring blind to labels and condition; analysis joins; no circular steps
value_reason: outcome-derived labels make any correlation forced by construction
risk_reason: no extra work if designed in
disposition_why: red line; keep always-on

check: Outcome codebook built on a named discovery slice, frozen, and prevalence estimated only on episodes that did not form it
value_reason: discovering and counting categories on the same rollouts is HARKing
risk_reason: needs held-out episodes before prevalence can be stated
disposition_why: applies only when a prevalence is reported; exploration can browse freely

check: Every eligible sample is in the computation; anything redacted or withheld logged with its reason; parse failures reported as a number
value_reason: quiet cohort shrinkage biases rates
disposition_why: cheap

check: Report every condition including failures, nulls and outliers; nothing quietly dropped
value_reason: selective reporting is the classic integrity failure
disposition_why: red line; stated three times, keep research-core as the home

check: Reviewer test: before any methodological shortcut ask if a reviewer would find it suspect; no 'just a quick analysis' exception
value_reason: catches shortcuts that change conclusions
risk_reason: read literally, it forbids quick exploratory analysis, the core of fast iteration
disposition_why: allow quick analyses labelled exploratory (U09); apply the reviewer test before a number is quoted

check: Independent skeptic review of findings (research-skeptic agent; cross-family council before publishing a result someone will act on; same-family self-check discouraged)
value_reason: an outside reader catches confounds the author misses
disposition_why: reserve for results about to be quoted

check: Sandbagging: organism = prompt + model pair; log prompt format; diff rendered prompts between runs; measure rather than assume instructed level
value_reason: format alone moved accuracy 23-30pp; one sentence removed the effect
disposition_why: domain-specific and cheap

check: Sandbagging: achieved test FPR beside every recall; dev/test disjointness asserted in landed logs; compared methods share k; thin negative groups not quoted as ratios
value_reason: 100% recall came with 84.8% FPR on an honest model (recorded)
disposition_why: domain-specific and cheap

check: Sandbagging: run the honest-wrong control (detector on honest models' incorrect answers) beside the headline
value_reason: separates sandbagging detection from error detection
risk_reason: one extra condition on existing data
disposition_why: the decisive control for this line of work

check: Sandbagging: check which pipeline produced an 'SE'; degenerate sqrt(p(1-p)) intervals are not quoted, point estimate alone with a note
value_reason: 39% of split-mode intervals on disk were [0,1]
disposition_why: domain-specific

check: J-Lens: evidencedTP/TP beside every TPR; noise floor from n=7 negatives (gaps < ~0.06 are noise); action-monitor ceiling on every plot; teacher-forced vs generation-time capture stated; manifest token totals reconciled
value_reason: aggregate CoT parity was hollow (9/115 evidenced)
disposition_why: domain-specific; the file is dated 2026-07-31, re-verify numbers

check: Monitoring analysis: monitor errors first, disagreements, comparative advantage, emergent taxonomy with prevalence on held-out episodes
value_reason: surfaces failure modes aggregates hide
disposition_why: usable as a prompt; no iteration cost

check: Show the ingredients: full prompts and templates, complete example transcripts (positive and negative), affordances, environment, held-constant vs varied, complete I/O for every model
value_reason: readers can spot errors only in what they see
disposition_why: generate from the manifest and JSONL rather than by hand

check: Every aggregate one click from its examples; sortable/filterable tables; transcripts readable at a glance; 10-20 examples comfortable to review
value_reason: manual inspection catches what metrics hide
risk_reason: publication-time; heavy UX only on first build
disposition_why: required for published results pages; interim updates can link raw JSONL

check: Provenance travels with every example: model, tokenizer/template, dataset/split, prompt version, sampling params, judge model and prompt hash, endpoint, date, training hyperparams
value_reason: needed to attribute and reproduce
disposition_why: same data as the run manifest (D01/U10)

check: HTML Artifact must carry the annotation layer (comments, export, labels); publish blocked otherwise
value_reason: review UX, not correctness
risk_reason: md2artifact adds it; blocks only hand-built pages
disposition_why: the only blocking hook in scope; not a rigour check

check: Results page fixed shape: at most three highlighted claims, claim -> figure -> caption -> setup -> implications -> caveats -> next steps; every condition linked
value_reason: presentation discipline
disposition_why: no iteration cost

check: Causal register matches the evidence; no pre-registration framing without a checkable registration
value_reason: overclaiming is a common reviewer objection
disposition_why: free

check: A number appears only where it discriminates; one measured quantity per paragraph; limitations stated once in one place
value_reason: readability, not correctness
disposition_why: free

check: Scan scripts, transcripts, prompts and configs for keys, endpoints, payloads and personal data before publishing
value_reason: security, not result correctness
disposition_why: irreversible failure class

check: Output directory explains the experiment on its own; analysis/plotting scripts saved with the results
value_reason: lets a colleague (or you next week) check the result
disposition_why: cheap with agents

check: Numbers carry provenance: no stated number without a tool call or source; computed numbers link to inputs; state confidence
value_reason: hallucinated numbers stated with measured-number confidence
risk_reason: nudge only, fires only on zero-tool turns
disposition_why: wire the Stop-hook nudge
